## Package

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Version | `0.2.0` |
| npm tag | `latest` |
| Channel | `latest` |
| Commit | [`7d325f3`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/7d325f3879afaa2991750cf249d348f905fb8603) |

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin @mirrowel/opencode-openshare@latest --global
```

## What's Changed

### Features
- feat(plugin): ✨ queued prompts surface by host semantics on both hosts ([`de0c2a7`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/de0c2a7a466898b68a8273a230b0fbfc63c9cc90)) by @Mirrowel
- feat(core): ✨ per-item rev deltas, engine-side content dedupe, hardening ([`3e095bb`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/3e095bbadf9fc4171741bb155bb68fce2510bed5)) by @Mirrowel
- feat(viewer+plugin): authoritative agent stamps; spacing via CSS attr; mojibake sweep; split-fit by real font metrics ([`0efead2`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/0efead26739fb9db27f8eb418c05f81b064c2350)) by @Mirrowel
- feat: big-session scale-out (B4) + worker deploy + docs for the v2 contract round ([`6892513`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/6892513ebe74fca8202d6aa97737ad02c6d04811)) by @Mirrowel
- feat(viewer)!: clean swap to the opencode v2 UI kit (contract-v2 native) ([`98d8d7a`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/98d8d7a00cd17e026cad7ec455aaa4a87d6d485e)) by @Mirrowel
- feat(contract)!: OpenShare transcript contract v2 — v2 content model end to end ([`5d248d3`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/5d248d3dda1e80be52704d21862e1cf7b25b983f)) by @Mirrowel
- feat(storage): sharded per-item DO storage, byte-aware sync chunking, big-session suite ([`c186c57`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/c186c57f10601149c4ef125c326b1a59644b9abe)) by @Mirrowel

### Fixes
- fix(tui): 🐛 explicit per-share consent and one session menu for /share ([`01f1f3b`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/01f1f3badec7202231de6ec7cf5a0d22d735cd81)) by @Mirrowel
- fix: 🐛 follow-up races, a bun viewer 404, and parity gaps ([`e192584`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/e192584d28a7df0574e4710844a83c235ea9f782)) by @Mirrowel
- fix: 🐛 close silent sync-loss windows and auth gaps across all layers ([`1e29641`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/1e29641fc000956be75897a253bb39b2caf72270)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(server): 🐛 apply user defaultTtlDays, add bun since parity, sync the docker lock ([`f96fbdd`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/f96fbdd4ac726795bc2021adcd572ce9ab63d2b6)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(viewer+plugin): spacing actually lands; split-diff deadlock; read highlighting; reader error passthrough; header order ([`339aa54`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/339aa54e4b6a224f3da7cb8d505504adf9964b05)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(viewer): full virtualization on every render path; measure livelock guard; readability batch ([`180f9e3`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/180f9e3f5800cbda5d06c4aba8f2c4eff4fa42e7)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(viewer+tui): upstream kit refresh, per-response tool rendering, grove split, scroll restoration ([`1b73913`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/1b73913190010f3780f42bc44b2b510a274ed9cb)) by @Mirrowel
- fix(viewer+plugin): live-round bugfixes — dark themes, per-response grouping, tombstone keys, row remeasure ([`7a5dea7`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/7a5dea7c6db277080d62e7f8dcfd4b0464e57f3a)) by @Mirrowel

### Performance
- perf: ⚡️ delta first frames for viewer websocket reconnects ([`5b95dbd`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/5b95dbdf84590d7505f14ba037b837b547bf69c8)) by @Mirrowel
- perf(plugin): ⚡️ serialize chunks once, dedupe the http fallback, debounce spool rewrites ([`13260d5`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/13260d547194a3b59145e39685659f10aabd99e0)) by @Mirrowel
- perf: ⚡️ single-serialization caches, bounded memory, stable backoff, memoized fold ([`c286c6c`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/commit/c286c6c464c445245d1b6c8cb7ed3f3fd2890c31)) by @Mirrowel
- pe

> [!WARNING]

>

### Community Contributions

Thank you to our community contributors!

- Viewer unification: two core views on one SDK (conversation view, prompt nav, search, reading & layout) ([#3](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/pull/3)) by @Mirrowel
- feat(viewer): file icons and a shared code surface on file cards ([#4](https://github.com/Mirrowel/openshare/pull/4)) by @OpeOginni
